description:
Runs Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI and other terminal coding agents together on one mission.

Runner is a native desktop application where terminal agents work together. Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor CLI, Grok Build, Antigravity CLI, Copilot CLI and pi can take the same task in one mission, and each agent keeps its own TUI in a real terminal while the lead brings the decisions back to you. Everything in Runner is also a `runner` command: missions, crews, roles, projects, chats, sessions and messages are all addressable from the command line, with `runnerd` as the background service. Agents run natively on Windows without WSL, and PowerShell 7 is optional. Status: alpha, actively shipping. Native builds target macOS (Apple Silicon) and Windows (x64) on Windows 10 version 1809 or later; Intel Macs, Windows ARM64 and Linux are not supported. The installer, the application and the CLI sidecars are Authenticode-signed with a Certum open-source certificate issued to Open Source Developer Yicheng Wang.
Runner 0.17.2 is a bug-fix release for macOS and Windows on top of 0.17.1.
New
- Choose how many roles and crews to show. Select 10, 25 or 50 rows per page. Runner remembers a separate choice for each list, keeps open windows in sync, and adapts pagination to narrow windows. (#1007)
Bug fixes
- Type Option-key characters on international Mac keyboards. The new Settings → Terminal → Option as Meta key setting defaults to Automatic: U.S., U.S. International and ABC layouts retain Meta shortcuts, while other layouts can type characters such as @, brackets and pipes. You can also choose both Option keys, either side individually, or Off; word-motion shortcuts remain available. Option+Space in character mode inserts a regular space. (#929)
- Keep wrapped terminal links together. Matching hyperlink fragments in the same table cell highlight together, with surrounding punctuation and neighboring cells excluded. Link destinations and identities are preserved through redraws and session reattachment. (#1006)
- Release mission messages when the live composer clears. Runner follows the current Antigravity and Claude Code input after redraws or resizing, preventing submitted text left in history from keeping the inbox waiting while continuing to hold messages for real drafts. (#995)
